title: Curator Mode for Creator Logs
description: An interactive UI to select and batch-delete logs from the Creator Log page. Requires migrating Astro to hybrid SSR mode with the Node.js adapter to allow API routes to dynamically splice the underlying JSON file.

title: Interactive D3.js Heatmaps for Option Greeks
description: Instead of a static HTML table, use fully interactive D3.js or WebGL 3D surfaces to visualize option sensitivity (Vega vs Theta) and stochastic reality for the SWP engine.
